messages:
maya: EdgeWave filed another billing discrepancy for May1Jul. They say ~3.2k units went unbilled. can partnerships + billing look?
priya: on it. can we get a sample event id or their CSV link?
maya: partner sent sample id ew-evt-20250705-4d2f and a CSV in their portal.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace export link: s3://marketplace-exports/edgewave/2025-07/usage_export_20250731.json
derek: likely causes: sku mapping and hourly-window attrition. i'll run a staging dry-replay and post results.
priya: triage plan: 1) confirm export row counts 2) left-join export -> raw_ingest to find missing ids 3) classify reasons (sku_mismatch/window_shift/filtered) 4) produce unmatched CSV for partner + finance.
liam: FYI our mapping file is infra/partner_mappings/edgewave.yml. i've seen EW-100 vs EW-HARDWARE-100 issues before.
ana: legal (ana): contract has a 90-day cap on retro credits unless partner provides device delivery evidence. flag any events outside that window.
finance-bot: Finance note: credits require documented evidence for out-of-policy adjustments. prefer credit memo over negative invoice line.
derek: dry-run complete  approx 365 records would be accepted after remap. uploading diff: s3://redwood-temp/edgewave/replay-diff-3333333333.json
priya: reconciliation job shows partner 3,200 rows, matched 2,835, unmatched 365. creating unmatched CSV now.
maya: action owners: maya -> partner comms; priya -> unmatched CSV + reason codes; derek -> hold prod replay until approvals; ana -> confirm contract limits; liam -> patch mapping if needed; finance-bot -> standby for credit memo request.
priya: ETA for CSV and root-cause table: EOD today. will update ticket RW-PRT-4601.
maya: thanks all. i'll message EdgeWave acknowledging receipt and that we're investigating mapping + windowing causes, and outline next steps.
